definition: verbosity_ratio — the completion-to-prompt token ratio must not exceed the maximum: pass when completion_tokens / prompt_tokens ≤ max_token_ratio, default 5 (config key max_token_ratio); skipped when token usage is not provided. docs/api-reference.md §Cost Rules. Positive = ratio strictly over the maximum (the rule should FAIL).
